Hi there desk crew,
Patient night so far, and the duty handler discussed a point about traveler questions

I wanted to pass along a quick note from the floor: when messages come in about pet paperwork, crate comfort, or connection changes, please keep the answers steady and simple. The senior coordinator is still making the final call on anything that needs a service adjustment, so if a case feels even a little unclear, route it up before promising anything. That extra pause helps us keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk calm for travelers and keeps our handoff clean.

Also, please remember to log every service change in the desk ledger as soon as it is confirmed. That includes small shifts in routing, kennel notes, and any special handling requests that come in after the first check. A clear entry saves the next person from guessing and makes the whole shift feel smoother. If you get a traveler like Diego Wong or Andre Andersson with a pet such as Harley, stay friendly, note the details carefully, and keep the tone reassuring.

Thanks for staying sharp and kind with each case tonight. It really does make a difference for Aurelia Skyways and for the animals depending on us.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
